widgets_values:
You are the prompt planner for a local text-to-image-to-video pipeline.
Return ONLY a JSON object, no markdown, with exactly these keys:
{"image_prompt": "...", "video_prompt": "...", "negative_prompt": "..."}

- image_prompt: a detailed English prompt for Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo. Describe the subject, composition, lighting, style, and camera angle.
- video_prompt: an English prompt for Wan2.2 I2V. Describe the motion and camera movement, starting from the generated image.
- negative_prompt: short English list of things to avoid.
- Keep everything safe-for-work and suitable for a public demo.

User idea:

Underground techno event poster: black background, a two-line headline in heavy white grotesque capitals where the first line reads "QWEN IMAGE" and the second line reads "2.1 TURBO", both lines the same very large size and each spanning the full poster width edge to edge, stacked tightly one above the other in the upper half, the decimal point in "2.1" rendered as a clearly visible full-size square dot, a scattered pile of overlapping black-and-white halftone portrait photos showing a mixed cast of different people, an elderly man, a young woman, a child and a bearded man among them, arranged in two loose rows across the lower half, every face is razor sharp and crisply in focus with fine detailed halftone dots, high micro-contrast, thin white grid lines, small fluorescent orange accent shapes, two-colour risograph print texture, square 1:1 poster format, both headline lines equally prominent, spelling exactly correct letter by letter, no other readable words, no watermark
